nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances in UniswapExchange; written without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances; directly decremented in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Private owner address used as the central access-control gate for privileged functions.
Address that is whitelisted inside ensure() and set by setTradeAddress.
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist flag toggled by _mints and read by ensure.
Maximum number of sales per address, checked in condition.
Minimum sale value, checked in condition.
Maximum sale value, checked in condition.
Per-address counter of completed transfers, incremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used as a scaling exponent in _mints and init.
Token name string.
Token symbol string.
Private ERC20 balance mapping updated by _transfer, _mint, _burn.
Private ERC20 allowance mapping updated by _approve.
Private ERC20 total supply adjusted in _mint and _burn.
Constant Uniswap router address compared against _from in ensure.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance and balance mutation with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view whitelist check that grants free transfers to owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale addresses.
Internal view sale-limit check used by ensure for non-whitelisted addresses.
Owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address, allowing storage takeover.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hard-coded address.
Owner-only sale parameter initializer.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via CREATE2.
Constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and initial balance/allowance.
Internal ERC20 _transfer using SafeMath for balance updates.
Internal ERC20 _approve writing the allowance mapping.
Private SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level call to an arbitrary token.
msg.sender: external caller used in access checks, allowance lookups and arithmetic paths.
delegatecall to an arbitrary address executing attacker code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance and balanceOf plus unchecked addition of balanceOf in transferFrom.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn.
_from address parameter of transferFrom/ensure.
_to address parameter of transferFrom/ensure.
_value amount parameter of transferFrom/ensure/condition.
_tos address array parameter of batchSend.
spender parameter of _mints.
addedValue parameter of _mints used as the minted balance.
saleNum parameter of init.
token parameter of init for _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init for _maxSale.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress.
Target address parameter of delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter passed to delegatecall.
amount parameter of the ERC20 transfer/approve entry points.
recipient parameter of the ERC20 transfer entry point.
total computed as _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index of the batchSend address loop.
_UNI pair address computed by pairFor in ensure.
_to element extracted per iteration in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
msg.sender determines the allowance branch and is credited/debited in transferFrom.
transferFrom requires the ensure() whitelist/limit check to pass.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure compares _from/_to against owner to bypass limits.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress to bypass limits.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass limits.
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is unchecked in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender must equal owner before the delegatecall is executed.
transferFrom contains the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Attacker-controlled caller reaches the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
batchSend contains the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication.
Owner caller supplies _value and array size driving the unchecked multiplication.
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level token call.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hard-coded address and sets canSale.
init is gated by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend is gated by msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress is gated by msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and the full supply to the deployer.
_from parameter indexes balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value amount parameter is subtracted/added without SafeMath in transferFrom.
_value is compared against _minSale/_maxSale in condition.
_tos array length and elements drive the unchecked total and loop in batchSend.
spender parameter receives the minted balance and whitelist flag in _mints.
addedValue is scaled by 10**decimals and assigned as balance in _mints.
saleNum parameter sets _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled by 10**decimals to set _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by 10**decimals to set _maxSale.
addr parameter becomes tradeAddress, a whitelist bypass in ensure.
target address parameter a is the delegatecall destination.
bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
amount parameter flows into the ERC20 transfer entry point.
recipient parameter flows into the ERC20 transfer entry point.
local total is the operand of the unchecked multiplication.
loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
computed _UNI pair address is compared with _from in ensure.
per-iteration _to element receives the credited balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as the indexed account inside transferFrom/ensure.
Parameter _to is only used as the credit target inside transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
_tos array exists solely to drive the batchSend loop and total computation.
spender is the mint recipient and whitelist key inside _mints.
addedValue is the mint amount assigned inside _mints.
saleNum is only written to _saleNum by init.
token is only scaled into _minSale by init.
maxToken is only scaled into _maxSale by init.
addr is only assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Address a is the delegatecall target of the unsafe delegatecall in delegate.
Bytes b is the payload of the unsafe delegatecall in delegate.
amount is consumed by the ERC20 transfer/approve entry points.
recipient is consumed by the ERC20 transfer entry point.
total is the direct operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Loop index i only controls iteration inside batchSend.
_UNI is a computed comparison value used only inside ensure.
Per-iteration _to element is only used inside the batchSend loop.
